sn13.9:1.2: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave puriso Himavato pabbatarājassa satta sāsapamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhippeyya || ||
sn13.9:1.4: Katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ yā vā satta sāsapamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhittā yo vā Himavā pabbatarājāti || || 3
sn13.9:2.1: Etad eva bhante bahutaraṃ yad idaṃ Himavā pabbatarājā ||
sn13.9:2.3: neva satimaṃ kalam upenti na sahassimam kalam upenti na satasahassinaṃ kalam upenti Himavantaṃ pabbatarājānam upanidhāya satta sāsapamattiyo pāsāṇasakkharā upanikkhittā ti || || 4
